scope: Actual separate Chromium browser contexts, real PeerJS signalling via local Vite proxy, real WebRTC data channels, Rapier and Three.js. Timer-driven simulation decoupled from software render captures; QA-only preserveDrawingBuffer and synchronous canvas image copy for reliable screenshots of background browser contexts. Low preset explicitly selected. Not public-service uptime, cross-NAT/TURN, sustained FPS or physical-device evidence.

checks.name: Host creates an actual ephemeral room with local signalling/WebRTC
Two independent browser clients exchange a real roster
Guest colour is synchronized to the host
Guest cannot start the host race
Shareable invitation contains the actual room code
Typing chat never drives the car
Live text chat crosses the peer connection
Chat is plain text, never injected HTML
Quick comments broadcast to the room
Host starts one shared countdown with the chosen lap count
Actual force-driven local movement is relayed to another browser
A real remote coloured car is rendered
Remote orientation follows the transmitted physics quaternion
Flight cannot be armed in multiplayer
Host owns finite nitro inventory and activation
Return-to-road recovery is host-authorized and adds a time penalty
An in-progress grid cannot be invaded by late arrivals
Host result snapshots populate both podiums
Only host can trigger a rematch
Rematch returns everyone to a fresh unready lobby
Host departure closes the guest session with a clear explanation
No browser runtime exceptions
